$comment: The one source for what NexaScan offers on Free and Pro. Checked against the app's code and product catalogue (config/PrivatePdfToolkit/product-catalog.json, catalogVersion 7) at app commit 178f39e (main, Google Play versionCode 11, the first Closed Testing build) on 2026-10-15; earlier checks: 1c4a9da / versionCode 10 on 2026-10-12, versionCode 8 with the installed app on 2026-10-08. Tool and group names are the ones on the app's All Tools screen. Change the app first, then this file. The Features and Pricing pages are generated from it. 'limit' is the Free limit; Pro lifts it (the app never promises 'unlimited'). A few per-run device limits apply to everyone, Pro included (the app's ToolPageLimits and RemovalLimits: Extract Text 10 pages, PDF to Images 20 (10 in its long-image format; the scanner's long image takes every page), Word 50, Remove Watermark / Handwriting 100 pages and 50 MB, with Check all pages up to 25 pages); the comparison rows and the Features details say so.

pricing.$comment: Prices come from Google Play at run time, not from the app. Set confirmed to true only when the owner confirms the production prices; until then the site says prices are shown in Google Play.

groups.name: Create
groups.summary: Turn paper and photos into PDFs.

tools.name: Scan Document
tools.benefit: Finds the page edges live and straightens every shot. Turn on Auto Capture and it takes the picture when the page is steady. It outlines TVs, monitors and picture frames too.

tools.name: Image to PDF
tools.benefit: Turn photos into one PDF, or one PDF per photo.

groups.name: Edit & Sign
groups.summary: Finish a document before it goes anywhere.

tools.name: Sign PDF
tools.benefit: Draw your signature and place it on any page, then save a signed copy.

tools.name: Crop & Enhance
tools.benefit: Open a PDF or photo as editable pages, then crop, rotate, retake, clean up, add text, drawing or a signature, and save a new copy.

tools.name: Edit PDF
tools.benefit: Write, draw, sign, obscure (pixelate) and watermark on any page, then save an edited copy.

tools.name: Add Page Numbers
tools.benefit: Number pages in the position and style you choose.

tools.name: Watermark PDF
tools.benefit: Add a text or logo watermark to a whole PDF.

tools.name: Remove Watermark
tools.benefit: Brush over a watermark or stamp on a PDF page or a photo. Similar marks are found and cleaned away, keeping your text. On a document of up to 25 pages, you can check the marks found on every page and remove them in one go. Saved as a new copy.

tools.name: Remove Handwriting
tools.benefit: Brush over pen or pencil marks on a PDF page or a photo. Similar strokes are found and cleaned away, keeping your text. Saved as a new copy.

tools.name: Merge PDF
tools.benefit: Combine PDFs in the order you choose.

tools.name: Split & Extract
tools.benefit: Pull out pages or ranges into new PDFs.

tools.name: Manage Pages
tools.benefit: Fix page order and orientation, or remove what you don't need. Rotate Pages, Reorder Pages and Delete Pages each do one of these jobs.

tools.name: Multi-Page Sheet
tools.benefit: Fit 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16 pages onto each sheet.

groups.name: View & OCR
groups.summary: Text recognition runs on your phone.

tools.name: Document Viewer
tools.benefit: Open PDFs and images, zoom, and search the text. Scanned pages are recognised on your phone first. Password-protected PDFs open once you enter the password.
tools.limit: scanned PDFs up to 10 pages for search

tools.name: Extract Text
tools.benefit: Recognise the text in a photo or scanned PDF, then copy or share it.

tools.name: Make Searchable PDF
tools.benefit: Add an invisible text layer so a scanned PDF can be searched and copied.

tools.name: OCR Document Viewer
tools.benefit: Select, copy and share text straight off scanned pages.

groups.name: Convert & Export
groups.summary: Get the file the next person needs.

tools.name: PDF / Image to Word
tools.benefit: Turn a PDF or a photo into a Word document.

tools.name: PDF / Image to Excel
tools.benefit: Tables become sheets, with numbers and dates kept as values.

tools.name: PDF to Images
tools.benefit: One JPEG per page, or with Pro, one long image of up to 10 pages.

tools.name: PDF / Image to Word Pro
tools.benefit: Word documents that follow the original page layout.

tools.name: PDF / Image to Excel Pro
tools.benefit: Spreadsheets that keep complex tables and formatting.

groups.name: Optimise & Protect
groups.summary: Make it smaller, or lock it.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.benefit: Shrink a PDF for email. Pro adds stronger Balanced and Maximum levels.

tools.name: Password Protect
tools.benefit: Save a password-protected copy with AES-256 encryption.
